newsitem.title: USA: Butler buys Modu-Line, issues shares.
newsitem.headline: Butler buys Modu-Line, issues shares.

text.p: Butler Manufacturing Co said Wednesday it acquired Modu-Line Windows Inc, issuing about $7 million in common shares for the purchase and paying about $4.5 million in cash to retire Modu-Line debt.
Butler chief financial officer John Holland said the acquisition is expected to be accretive to Butler's 1997 earnings per share.
Modu-Line, with annual revenues of about $16 million, manufactures windows for non-residential buildings.
Modu-Line, based in Wausau, Wis., will be integrated into Butler's Vistawall division, which supplies storefronts, curtain walls and skylight systems.
Modu-Line windows will continue to be manufactured in Wausau and marketed through the Modu-Line sales network, Butler said.
Butler produces pre-engineered buliding systems and supplies specialty and construction services for the non-residential construction market.
